instructions.text: Heat one cupful of sweet milk until boiling
Beat together the whites of two eggs, a tablespoonful of white sugar and a piece of butter the size of a nutmeg
Add half a cupful of cold milk and a teaspoonful of cornstarch
Stir well together until very light and smooth
Add it to the boiling milk
Cook it until it thickens; it must not boil

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Heat one cupful of sweet milk until boiling
2. Beat together the whites of two eggs, a tablespoonful of white sugar and a piece of butter the size of a nutmeg
3. Add half a cupful of cold milk and a teaspoonful of cornstarch
4. Stir well together until very light and smooth
5. Add it to the boiling milk
6. Cook it until it thickens; it must not boil
7. Set it aside to cool
8. Serve in a creamer
